## Mission framing

::: {.kicker}
Overview and requirements
:::

:::: {.grid-3}
::: {.card .blue}
::: {.label}
Incoming data
:::

- ~400 GB of L0 data per day
- ~8 passes per day
- ~50 GB every 3 hours
:::

::: {.card .green}
::: {.label}
Operational product deadlines
:::

- L2 NRT target: ~24 hours
- L2 target: ~1 week
- L2.5 and L3 target: ~1 month
:::

::: {.card .amber}
::: {.label}
Program milestones
:::

- L0 → L1 beta by 12/2026
- L2 / L2.5 alpha by 12/2026
- L3 product definition by 12/2026
:::
::::

::: {.banner}
The goal is to create a pipeline that can keep up with regular arrivals and meet all downstream product timelines
:::

## What this schedule implies

::: {.kicker}
Overview and requirements
:::

:::: {.grid-2}
::: {.card .blue}
::: {.label}
Immediate implications
:::

- Each incoming L0 batch needs to be processed before the next batch arrives
- The L0 → L2 path is the main focus to ensure we have enough throughput
- "Placeholder" calibration used for framework and systems testing
:::

::: {.card .amber}
::: {.label}
Where uncertainty remains
:::

- L2.5 and L3 compute costs and runtimes are still uncertain
  - Torch solvers are under active development
- Final L0 → L1 science algorithms will change runtime and memory requirements
- Host qualification still matters even if framework tests already look promising
:::
::::
